ids.description: List of entity ids to run the {@link DataDiagnostic} logic on.

filter.description: Filter on {@link DataDiagnostic#srcType} to specify which entities to run the logic on.

title:
Type passed into {@link DataTag} via {@link DataDiagnosticOverrideSpec}
which can optionally specify a different set of entities to run the diagnostic logic on than the ones specified in the
diagnostic itself. Only either the list of ids or the filter is used, with the ids taking
precedence over the filter if both are supplied.
name: DataDiagnosticFilterSpec
